tips.text: Stay through the fourth reward before deciding to quit; most public players leave at the third, mistaking it for Rotation C.
Run public matchmaking, not solo; Remnants spawn faster with more kills and one player can defend while another collects.
Bring Titania to collect Remnants fastest with Razorwing; Jade, Wukong, Uriel and Chroma also work.
Only leave on a multiple of four rounds to keep enemy levels down and teammates around.
Hold your fragments until only one or two parts are missing, then buy those so a late drop cannot duplicate a purchase.
Expect duplicate main blueprints; nothing converts a duplicate into fragments.
Skip boosters and Smeeta Charm; they do not affect fragment or part drops.
Grab the bulk of Remnants that spawn in the 30-second Void tunnel.
Run it on Steel Path if your gear holds; players put a full frame at three to four hours there against four to five on normal.
To solo it, hold the crystal with a New Loka Ancient Guardian Specter, a Loki Damage Decoy, a Frost bubble or Vauban's Enduring Bastille.
Do not rely on Warframe heals for the crystal; only Remnant pickups restore its health.
Vacuum, Fetch, Mag's Pull, Limbo's Rift and Wukong's Cloud Walker cannot pick up Remnants.
Do not spend fragments on arcanes at Otak; they cost 60 of each per copy.
Players consistently rank Citrine among the worst frame farms, tedious rather than hard.
Players who stay to Rotation C in public squads report four to six hours for the full frame.
